decision.rationale: The confirmed SMS latency spike and suspected AI traffic-management model involvement constitute a significant degradation of a public telecommunications service, so I will report the confirmed fact to the telecom regulator, investigate the network fault, suspend the new AI traffic-management model, and request incident-status information from the regulator. I do not yet know the confirmed root cause, whether patient or health data are involved, or whether the regulator has issued any determination.

citations.quote_span: Illustrative rule, not a quotation: a licensed telecom operator reports to the telecom regulator any network incident that significantly degrades a public telecommunications service, within 60 minutes of becoming aware of it.
citations.relevance: Supports reporting the confirmed SMS latency spike and suspected model-related fault to the telecom regulator.

citations.quote_span: Illustrative rule, not a quotation: the telecom regulator may request from a licensed operator information about a network incident affecting a public telecommunications service.
citations.relevance: Supports requesting information from the regulator about the incident and any related determinations.

Whether any patient account records or health data are affected is unknown.
